decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API has kept its own page for two years and sits close to the firm's core messaging platform, so its marginal cost is low; a large firm's slack lets it carry the product without needing proof that it beats the aspiration level.

The email-to-SMS gateway is a recent, low-cost extension of existing SMS infrastructure, and with no signal of a shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search, so management keeps it while results remain uncertain.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B on the same technical base, and slack plus the absence of evidence that it falls below aspiration make keeping it the satisficing choice.
